speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Fellow warriors, this is Sheldor the Conqueror. We are about to enter Axel's fortress. Now this is a long run, so let's do another bladder check. Alright Barry, we'll wait for you again, but you really should see a doctor. Sheldor is AFK.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Penny, are you experiencing some sort of difficulty?

speaker: penny
text: Yes, I can't get my stupid door open.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You appear to have put your car key in the door lock, are you aware of that? Alright then.

speaker: penny
text: Dammit, dammit, dammit, dammit, dammit, dammit.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Would it be possible for you to do this a little more quietly?

speaker: penny
text: I can't get the damned key out.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well that's not surprising. That Baldwin lock on your door uses traditional edge mounted cylinders, whereas the key for your Volkswagon uses a centre cylinder system.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: You're welcome. Point of inquiry, why did you put your car key in the door lock?

speaker: penny
text: Why? I'll tell you why. Because today I had an audition, it took me two hours to get there, I waited an hour for my turn, and before I could even start they told me I looked too Midwest for the part. Too Midwest? What the hell does that even mean?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well, the American Midwest was mostly settled by Scandinavian and Germanic peoples who, well they have a characteristic facial bone structure....

speaker: penny
text: I know what it means, Sheldon! God, you know, I have been in L.A. for almost two years now, and I haven't got a single acting job, I have accomplished nothing, haven't gotten a raise at work, haven't even had sex in six months, and just now when I was walking up those stairs a fly flew in my mouth and I ate it.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well, actually, insects are a dietary staple in many cultures, they're almost pure protein.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I believe the condensation on your frozen foods weakened the structural integrity of the bag.
